title: Web: Home food detail
description: GET /api/coach/home/food?day=YYYY-MM-DD. The check-in week holding the day (the 7 days the weekly check-in judges, start..end; Monday-Sunday without a check-in day), each day from start to `date` eaten against its daily target. so_far totals the complete days only; its target and deviation are null when any of them has no target.

iso_week.description: The ISO week of `end`, as the check-in names the week.

balance_kcal.description: Eaten minus the day's estimated burn (its target without the planned surplus): positive a surplus, negative a deficit. Null without food or outside a phase (balance.py).

balance.description: The complete days' balances added up, and that as kg at maintenance_estimate.kcal_per_kg (a rough guide); kcal and kg null without any.
